title: Spectrum DM26PB-Pro Petrol Leaf Blower - Lightweight, Powerful & Anti-Vibration
description_html:
Spectrum DM26PB-Pro Petrol Leaf Blower

Lightweight Performance. Professional Results.

Whether you’re clearing autumn leaves, tidying up after mowing, removing hedge trimmings, sweeping away sawdust or even clearing light snowfall, the Spectrum DM26PB-Pro Petrol Leaf Blower delivers powerful, reliable performance all year round.

The DM26PB-Pro has been refined to make garden maintenance even easier. Powered by a high-performance 26cc, 1hp, two-stroke air-cooled engine, it generates a powerful stream of air capable of shifting stubborn leaves, grass clippings and other garden debris quickly and efficiently, helping you complete larger jobs in less time.

Lighter Weight for Greater Comfort

Weighing just over 4kg, the DM26PB-Pro is lighter than other models on the market of it’s equivalent, making it easier to manoeuvre and reducing fatigue during prolonged use. Its balanced design provides excellent control, allowing you to work comfortably around flower beds, paths, patios and larger garden areas.

Anti-Vibration Technology

For improved operator comfort, the DM26PB-Pro incorporates an advanced anti-vibration system, significantly reducing vibrations transmitted through the handles. This allows for smoother operation and makes longer clearing sessions much more comfortable.

Variable Airflow with Throttle Lock

The variable-speed throttle gives you complete control over the blowing force, whether you’re delicately clearing leaves from borders or producing maximum airflow for stubborn debris.

When tackling larger areas, the integrated throttle lock allows continuous operation without constantly holding the throttle trigger, reducing hand fatigue and making extended jobs much more comfortable.

Three Blowing Configurations

The DM26PB-Pro is supplied with both a fan nozzle and a jet nozzle, giving you the flexibility to tailor the airflow to the task:

  • Fan Nozzle – Produces a wide airflow, ideal for quickly clearing large areas such as lawns, driveways and patios.
  • Jet Nozzle – Delivers a concentrated, high-velocity stream of air for moving heavier, stubborn or wet debris.
  • Standard Blower Tube – Remove the Jet nozzle tip for when a general-purpose airflow is preferred.

This versatility makes the DM26PB-Pro equally effective for everyday garden maintenance and more demanding clearing tasks.

Like all premium Spectrum garden machinery, the DM26PB-Pro is backed by an extended five-year manufacturer’s warranty for added peace of mind.*

*Terms & Conditions apply. To maintain the extended warranty, the machine must be serviced annually from the beginning of year two. (Domestic user only)
